label: Делая
description: A 10-sentence card for делая, the imperfective gerund of делать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Front position. Делая comes from the present stem of делать (дела-ют) plus -я. The fronted gerund names the activity happening at the same time as the main verb слушал — he did homework while listening.

missions.phrase: Она пела, делая зарядку у окна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: End position. Here делая closes the sentence and runs parallel to пела. Both actions share the subject она and unfold together — singing and exercising at once.
Strategic focus: Present tense. The main verb учимся is present, and делая marks the simultaneous circumstance: by making mistakes, we learn. The gerund itself shows no tense ending.
Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The one who makes the choice in делая must be the one addressed by помни — a single implied subject ты. A gerund cannot introduce a separate doer of its own.

missions.phrase: Делая ремонт, отец насвистывал старую мелодию.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb насвистывал is past, yet делая marks concurrency: while doing repairs, he whistled. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not a finished prior step.

missions.phrase: Завтра, делая доклад, ты будешь нервничать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (будешь нервничать), but делая stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. The doing and the nervousness will coincide.

missions.phrase: Делая всё спокойно, она никогда не спешит.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the feminine subject она the gerund stays делая, taking no feminine or singular ending. A participle would inflect; the gerund keeps one fixed shape always.
Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject рабочие, делая does not change to a plural form. Indeclinability means one gerund serves every person and number.

missions.phrase: Делая зарядку каждое утро, ты крепнешь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Habitual present. The main verb крепнешь describes a regular result, and делая gives the accompanying routine: doing exercises each morning, you grow stronger. Both verbs share the subject ты.

missions.phrase: Делая покупки, она встретила старую подругу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Она is the shared subject of both делая and встретила, the actions overlapping in time. The gerund folds while she was shopping into a single indeclinable word.
